name: Captured art plate
purpose: A 2x raster plate of the original's artwork, taken with the page copy hidden, over which live DOM copy is positioned at its measured rect.

responsive.note: CSS zoom scales the artboard so sticky layers keep working
plate stacks above the copy, which reflows

motion.evidence: Captured videos and GIFs play as real elements; sticky layers stick at their measured top. Widget motion baked into a plate stays FROZEN — see the known-frozen list at HANDOFF.md:284-290.

caveat: Motion inside a plate cannot be generated. Do not write a motion contract claiming live interactivity for a plate-backed section.
